title: Earning, Expiry and Redemption of Loop+ Promotional Credit
content:
Promotional Loop+ credit is an amount a Loop+ Membership member earns on qualifying orders and applies to later orders. The member's promotional credit balance is the running sum of credits earned, less credits redeemed and credits expired.

## Rule

A member in trial or active status earns the No-Rush credit for each order where No-Rush delivery is chosen, and the late-delivery credit when an order on one of the late-credit delivery options is delivered with its delivery promise met indicator showing missed, no more than the plan's late credits per billing cycle. Credit earned in one calendar month never exceeds the plan's monthly earn cap; earnings beyond it are not booked. Each credit expires after its validity days counted from the earning date, and the unused part is expired. Credits are applied oldest first. Every use of a benefit is recorded with its benefit code.

## Earning

| Credit | Earned when | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| No-Rush credit | the member, in trial or active status, chooses No-Rush delivery on an order; one credit per order | the monthly earn cap |
| Late-delivery credit | the member, in trial or active status, has an order on one of the plan's late-credit delivery options delivered with the delivery promise missed; one credit per order | the plan's late credits per billing cycle, and the monthly earn cap |

Each earned credit is recorded against the order that earned it, with its type (No-Rush or late-delivery), its amount and its expiry date.

**Counting the late credits of a billing cycle.** The late-delivery credits of the current billing cycle are those earned from the start of the period covered by the membership's latest fee charge up to the handling date.

**Counting the monthly earn cap.** Credit earned in a calendar month is the total amount of credit of every type earned on the membership with an earning date in that calendar month.

## Expiry and redemption

Each credit expires after its validity days counted from the earning date; whatever part of it is still unused at that point is expired, and the expired amount leaves the balance. When credit is applied to an order, the oldest credit is applied first.

## Hypothetical cases

- **Cap reached.** On a plan with a monthly earn cap of 10.00, a member has already earned 10.00 of credit in April. A further No-Rush order in April would take April's earnings beyond the cap, so it is not booked.
- **Below the cap.** The same member has earned 3.00 in May; a No-Rush order earning 1.00 is booked, bringing May's earnings to 4.00.
- **Cycle limit.** On a plan that allows 1 late-delivery credit per billing cycle, a member already earned one late-delivery credit in the current cycle; a second late Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day order in the same cycle earns no further late-delivery credit.
- **Oldest first.** A member holds a credit earned on 2 March and another earned on 20 March; an order to which credit is applied draws on the 2 March credit first.

## Benefit records

Every use of a membership benefit is recorded on the membership with its benefit code and the order number or streaming session reference it relates to.
